name: Ms. Sato
source: The alluring homeroom teacher that every male student has their eye on. No one ever misses her class and it's clear to know why. She's stern, serious, strict, and has a low tolerance for BS. Your goal of this game is to turn this super serious woman into your sexual plaything.
